hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Following catastrophic midterm election losses that handed control of Congress to Democrats, intense internal strife has erupted across the MAGA movement and Republican leadership. Figures like Vice President JD Vance and Representative Thomas Massie are openly blaming President Donald Trump's involvement in the Iran war and economic pressures for the defeat, leading to impeachment threats against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and broader conservative recriminations.
hotspots.affect: The complete collapse of the Republican congressional majority has triggered fierce existential panic, frantic blame-shifting, and open rebellion against Trump's foreign policy and party dominance.

hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Tensions surrounding Poland's Constitutional Tribunal (TK) have reached a boiling point as Law and Justice (PiS) leader Jarosław Kaczyński declared the ruling coalition's actions amount to an ongoing coup d'état. PiS has launched a specialized parliamentary team to prosecute government officials involved in the standoff, alleging severe constitutional crimes carrying life imprisonment, while President Karol Nawrocki faces intense scrutiny over his conduct at the tribunal.
hotspots.affect: The legal and political battle over state institutions is framed in maximum existential terms, combining accusations of high treason and violent subversion with aggressive institutional retaliation.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his presidential runoff defeat to President Lula, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has fled Brazil for the United States, vowing to take details of his departure 'to the grave' while staying at Mar-a-Lago for CPAC events. The escape has sparked intense political uproar in Brasilia and Washington, with US Democratic lawmakers demanding his immediate deportation and Brazilian authorities investigating his international movements.
hotspots.affect: The high-stakes flight of the key Bolsonarista leader fuels narrative clashes over judicial persecution, dynastic downfall, and international sanctuary.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Madrid Visit & Vox Alliance
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei's visit to Madrid for the Ibero-American Summit produced high diplomatic friction, marked by a visibly icy encounter with Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. Milei used his stage to equate socialism directly with political fascism, while bypassing state protocol to reinforce his exclusive ideological alliance with Vox leader Santiago Abascal.
hotspots.affect: Milei's aggressive rhetoric against host-country leadership creates high-friction diplomatic drama, celebrated as anti-leftist defiance by allies and condemned as unprecedented provocation by critics.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National (RN) president Jordan Bardella and Marine Le Pen are advancing their 2027 presidential program, proposing constitutional budget limits and economic policy shifts while Bardella rolls out his new book 'Gouverner'. The push has provoked sharp rebuffs from traditional right-wing figures like Bruno Retailleau, alongside intense media debates surrounding RN's stance on fiscal policy and public security.
hotspots.affect: The early mobilization for the 2027 Élysée contest draws high media focus and sharp friction with mainstream conservative rivals vying to block RN's momentum.
